headline: Gold Prices in Pakistan Surge by Rs 7,800 to Reach Rs 384,136 Per Tola
summary: Domestic gold prices in Pakistan rose on Monday in line with international gains, reaching Rs 384,136 per tola after a daily increase of Rs 7,800.
why: Gold serves as a traditional inflation hedge and retail investment asset in Pakistan's domestic market.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Local gold prices surged in Pakistan following international spot market price increases.
